entities.summary: Bruno Campese is a Canadian ice hockey goaltender. He was selected by the Boston Bruins in the 12th round of the 1982 NHL Entry Draft. Until 2015, Campese was the general manager of the Prince Albert Raiders in the Western Hockey League (WHL).
